plugin-top-stories.name: Top Stories
plugin-top-stories.description: Shows Google-style top stories from your news engines for newsworthy searches.
plugin-top-stories.heading: Top stories

freshHours.label: Freshness window
freshHours.description: Stories older than this are ignored. Top stories appear only when at least three stories are this fresh.

triggerMode.label: When to look for stories
triggerMode.description: The first option runs short topic searches on your news engines and shows stories only when most results are fresh. The second option looks only when a search mentions news (for example news, headlines, breaking or latest).
